name: imessage-archive
description: Back up a trusted, unlocked iPhone with libimobiledevice and browse Messages using imessage-exporter. Includes indexed search, scrollable conversation parts, HTML/text/CSV/ZIP exports, and resumable PDF rendering with image quality controls and progress. Requires a Linux amd64 host and USB pairing before backup. Privileged mode grants broad host access for USB hotplug: install only on a trusted private server. Encrypted backups are supported, but generated exports are not encrypted. Set a unique administrator password and session secret before use. Scheduled Wi-Fi backup requires an already paired, network-visible device.

paths.name: Exports
paths.description: HTML, text, media and portable ZIP files. Keep this share private.

paths.name: USB Bus
paths.description: USB bus bind mount for device hotplug; privileged mode grants device access.

variables.name: Read-only username
variables.description: Optional account that can browse and download only

variables.name: Read-only password
variables.description: Leave blank to disable the read-only account

variables.name: Session secret
variables.description: Private login-session signing key, NOT a login or iPhone backup password. Generate once in the Unraid terminal with openssl rand -hex 32; paste the 64-character output and retain it across upgrades. See the README configuration guide.

variables.name: Secure cookies
variables.description: Use 1 only when the Web UI is served through HTTPS

variables.name: USB multiplexer
variables.description: Start the container USB service. Only one usbmuxd should own the phone; do not run competing backup containers.

variables.name: Conversation part size
variables.description: Messages per viewer/PDF part; smaller parts reduce browser and PDF memory use.

variables.name: Image workers
variables.description: Concurrent PDF image conversions. Higher values need more RAM.

variables.name: PDF part timeout
variables.description: Maximum seconds per Chromium render; successful parts are resumable.
